clue.text: Political leader served well, backed in split

indicators.note: backed means the run made by the leader and the serve is read from end to start

parts.note: PM, the Prime Minister, leads the government
a tennis player who served an unreturnable ball aced it

explanation.surface: A party leader, having served well, finds the party splitting behind them.
explanation.walkthrough: One reversal indicator, 'backed', turns the leader and the serve together. 'Split' is the slang verb meaning to leave in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: To split is slang for leaving abruptly, the same idea as running off from a camp.

clue.text: Under protest, about to desert as party member

indicators.note: in a down entry, pieces placed under another come after it

parts.note: a demo is a protest march
to rat is to desert one's side

explanation.surface: A party member grudgingly reaches the point of quitting the party.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, pieces said to be 'Under' another are written below it, so they follow it in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A Democrat is a member of the US Democratic Party, a political grouping.

clue.text: Preserve what American and Canadian share in different places

definitions.meaning: to preserve food is to seal it in a tin

definitions.text: what American and Canadian share in different places
definitions.meaning: the same three letters close one nationality word and open the other

explanation.definitionFit: To can fruit is to preserve it, and those three letters end one word and begin the other.

clue.text: Red Cross is located in trade centre

indicators.note: located in means the cross and the word is sit inside the trade centre

parts.note: a mart is a market, a centre of trade

explanation.surface: The Red Cross has set up its office in a commercial hub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Red Cross' reads as the charity, but Red is the definition and Cross is X.
explanation.definitionFit: Red is a common label for a communist or socialist, as a follower of Marx is.

clue.text: I have returned and converted older sinner

indicators.note: returned means the contraction for I have is read backwards
converted means the letters of older are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A reformed sinner comes back, converted in later life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns IVE into EVI; 'converted' makes LDOER from OLDER.
explanation.definitionFit: A sinner is a wrongdoer, someone who does evil things.

clue.text: Result of bluntness? It helps one maintain a proper perspective

definitions.meaning: a pencil worn blunt has lost its tip, whimsically read as its sharp end disappearing

definitions.text: It helps one maintain a proper perspective
definitions.meaning: in perspective drawing, parallel lines converge on a point on the horizon

explanation.definitionFit: In perspective drawing parallel lines meet at the vanishing point; a blunt pencil's tip has also vanished.

clue.text: Vigorously proceeds with triples, ringing the changes

indicators.note: bell-ringers ring changes by varying the order, so the letters of triples are reordered

explanation.surface: Bell-ringers set to work energetically on a sequence of triples.
explanation.walkthrough: Triples is a real bell-ringing method, which makes 'ringing the changes' sit naturally in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Lets rip is an idiom for acting with full force and no restraint.

clue.text: It shows views of race if it's a cross-country event

definitions.text: It shows views of race if it's a cross-country event

parts.words: It shows views of race if it's a cross-country event
parts.note: a survey shows people's views; read as a race, a cross-country event, the second word is a punning take on a polling day contest

explanation.definitionFit: A survey of public opinion reveals people's views, and one across a country is a national event.

clue.text: Viable idea for athlete

definitions.meaning: an idea that might work is a ..., as in 'that plan is a non-starter' reversed

explanation.definitionFit: A workable proposal is informally called a runner, and a track athlete is a runner too.

clue.text: Name found in compilation of elite brain set

definitions.text: Name found in compilation of elite brain set

indicators.note: found in means the letter for name is placed among the rearranged letters
a compilation puts material together afresh, so the three words' letters are reordered

explanation.surface: The name you would find in any list of the best brains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'compilation of' is the anagram signal and 'found in' the insertion; read whole, the clue also describes the physicist, so it is an all-in-one.
explanation.definitionFit: The physicist behind relativity is the archetypal genius, a fixture of any roll of great minds.

clue.text: Lone trip man organized to get rock from space

indicators.note: organized means the letters of the three words are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A solo traveller gets an excursion organized to collect a meteorite.
explanation.definitionFit: An asteroid is a small rocky body orbiting the sun, also called a minor planet.

clue.text: River providing watering hole

definitions.meaning: the ... flows through Switzerland, Austria and Germany
a pub or tavern where one drinks

explanation.definitionFit: The Inn is an Alpine river, and an inn is a pub, a place to drink.

clue.text: Legal system governing drug and analgesic

parts.note: a code is a body of laws
a party governing is in power

explanation.surface: A legal code that regulates both street drugs and painkillers.
explanation.definitionFit: Codeine is an opiate painkiller, an analgesic.

clue.text: Party was angry about university being opposed

parts.note: a disco is a dance party

explanation.surface: A party-goer fumed about a university that was against something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is read as 'concerning', a link here; the pieces simply run in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Something discouraged is frowned on, which is to say opposed by those in charge.

clue.text: Stonefish?

parts.note: a small fish whose name begins with a gemstone, sard, read as a fish of stone

explanation.definitionFit: The small fish packed in tins starts with sard, a reddish gemstone, so it is whimsically a stone fish.

clue.text: Like groups making mistakes in profitable division of business

explanation.surface: Teams keep making errors in the money-making part of a company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'division' looks like a company department; here it means breaking a company up.
explanation.definitionFit: Buying a firm and selling off its assets separately divides the business for profit.

clue.text: Temporary fastening? Yank can undo it

definitions.meaning: a knot designed to be released easily rather than hold for good
a sharp tug on the free end releases this knot

explanation.walkthrough: 'Yank' looks like an American; it is a hard pull.
explanation.definitionFit: A slipknot is a quick-release knot that comes undone when its end is pulled.

clue.text: Getting on with swimming group in Eton, say

parts.note: boarding a train or ship is getting on it
a school is a group of fish or whales

explanation.surface: Climbing aboard with a swim team at Eton.
explanation.walkthrough: ETON is a famous English private school where pupils live in.
explanation.definitionFit: Eton College is an example of a school where pupils live during term.

clue.text: Progressive diverging from centre occupied by Conservative

indicators.note: occupied by means the Conservative letter sits inside the word for spreading out

parts.note: radial lines spread out from a centre

explanation.surface: A progressive moves away from the centre ground the Tories hold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre' suggests political centrism; it is the hub of a wheel.
explanation.definitionFit: A radical is a reformer pressing for change, a progressive.

clue.text: Among some Indians, church provides child-care facilities

indicators.note: among means the church abbreviation sits inside the tribal name

parts.note: the Cree are a Native American people

explanation.surface: A church runs nurseries among a Native American community.
explanation.walkthrough: The Cree are a Native American people of Canada; 'Among' signals the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: A crèche is a nursery where small children are looked after.

clue.text: British competitor needed a stiff drink

explanation.surface: A British racer needed a stiff drink after the event.
explanation.definitionFit: A bracer is a tonic, usually a strong drink, taken to brace oneself.

clue.text: Red rose arranged as decoration for altar

indicators.note: flowers arranged, and here the letters of red rose rearranged

explanation.surface: A red rose put in a display to decorate a church altar.
explanation.definitionFit: A reredos is an ornamental screen behind a church altar.

clue.text: Past friend's return is a bit of a coincidence

indicators.note: return means the word for friend is read backwards

explanation.surface: An old friend coming back is something of a coincidence.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things that overlap partly coincide, covering some of the same ground.

clue.text: Minor employee, one engaged in revolutionary activity

definitions.meaning: a small ... in a big machine is an unimportant worker
a tooth on a gearwheel meshes with others as the wheel turns

explanation.definitionFit: A cog is a lowly worker and also a gear tooth that turns round and round.

clue.text: Barefaced conman, initially, is inclined to take refuge

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of conman is taken

explanation.surface: A brazen swindler is inclined to lie low somewhere safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barefaced' suggests brazen; here it means beardless.
explanation.definitionFit: A clean-shaven face is literally bare of beard or stubble.

clue.text: By means of article, supporting sex

indicators.note: in a down entry a supporting piece sits below, so it comes after

parts.note: sex is Latin for six, VI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A newspaper article backing sex education.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sex' is Latin for six, so VI.
explanation.definitionFit: Via means through or by way of, using something as a means.

clue.text: Sifting through wordplay

definitions.meaning: a riddle is a coarse sieve

explanation.definitionFit: To riddle soil is to sieve it; riddling also means speaking in puzzles.

clue.text: A singular philosopher regarded thus with suspicion

explanation.surface: A lone philosopher was viewed with distrust.
explanation.definitionFit: Askant means sideways or askance, a sidelong look of doubt or mistrust.
